legal.title: Affiliate disclosures
legal.intro: Zakka shows two kinds of offers. Items marked “Sold by Zakka” are sold and supported by Zakka. Items marked “Partner store” are sold by another shop: when you continue to that store and buy, Zakka may earn a commission. The price you pay is the same.
legal.amazon: As an Amazon Associate, Zakka earns from qualifying purchases.
legal.others: Zakka also takes part in the affiliate programs of Temu, Shein, AliExpress, Jumia, noon and Flipkart, and may earn a commission on qualifying purchases made through links on Zakka.
legal.ranking: Commissions never change the price shown to you, and affiliate offers are always labelled “Partner store”.
